content.json:
# Azure Monitor — Data Collection Rules
---
Inventory of all DCRs in the selected scope with source and destination types, transformation status, and target assignment count.

> **Tip:** Click a row in the DCR grid to expand the list of associated targets below.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource Group
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/datacollectionrules'
| distinct resourceGroup
| order by resourceGroup asc
| project value = resourceGroup, label = resourceGroup

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/datacollectionrules'
| where resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| extend dcrId = tolower(id)
| extend dataSources = properties.dataSources
| extend destinations = properties.destinations
| extend dataFlows = properties.dataFlows
// Build source-type label
| extend srcList = trim(', ', strcat(
    iff(array_length(dataSources.performanceCounters) > 0, 'PerfCounters, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.performanceCountersOTel) > 0, 'OtelPerfCounters, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.windowsEventLogs) > 0, 'WindowsEvents, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.syslog) > 0, 'Syslog, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.extensions) > 0, 'Extensions, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.logFiles) > 0, 'LogFiles, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.iisLogs) > 0, 'IISLogs, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(dataSources.prometheusForwarder) > 0, 'Prometheus, ', '')))
| extend srcList = iff(isempty(srcList), 'None', srcList)
// Extract actual destination resource names; fall back to generic labels for types without a named resource ID
| extend la_name = iff(array_length(destinations.logAnalytics) > 0, tostring(split(tostring(destinations.logAnalytics[0].workspaceResourceId), '/')[-1]), '')
| extend amw_name = iff(array_length(destinations.monitoringAccounts) > 0, tostring(split(tostring(destinations.monitoringAccounts[0].accountResourceId), '/')[-1]), '')
| extend dstList = trim(', ', strcat(
    iff(isnotempty(la_name), strcat(la_name, ', '), ''),
    iff(isnotempty(amw_name), strcat(amw_name, ', '), ''),
    iff(isnotnull(destinations.azureMonitorMetrics), 'AzMon Metrics, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(destinations.eventHubs) > 0, 'Event Hub, ', ''),
    iff(array_length(destinations.storageAccounts) > 0, 'Storage, ', '')))
| extend dstList = iff(isempty(dstList), 'None', dstList)
| extend primaryDstId = iff(isnotempty(la_name), tostring(destinations.logAnalytics[0].workspaceResourceId),
    iff(isnotempty(amw_name), tostring(destinations.monitoringAccounts[0].accountResourceId), ''))
// Detect KQL transformations: any dataFlow with transformKql set to something other than the passthrough 'source'
| extend dataFlowsStr = tostring(dataFlows)
| extend hasTransform = case(
    not (dataFlowsStr contains 'transformKql'), 'No',
    dataFlowsStr contains '"transformKql":"source"', 'No',
    dataFlowsStr contains '"transformKql": "source"', 'No',
    'Yes')
// Count associations
| join kind=leftouter (
    insightsresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/datacollectionruleassociations'
    | where isnotempty(tostring(properties.dataCollectionRuleId))
    | extend dcrId = tolower(tostring(properties.dataCollectionRuleId))
    | where isnotnull(properties.dataCollectionRuleId)
    | summarize Targets = count() by dcrId
) on dcrId
| extend Targets = coalesce(Targets, 0)
| project id, name,
    ['Resource Group'] = resourceGroup,
    Location = location,
    Kind = iff(isempty(tostring(properties.kind)), 'Standard', tostring(properties.kind)),
    Sources = srcList,
    Destinations = dstList,
    primaryDstId,
    Transformation = hasTransform,
    Targets
| order by name asc
content.title: Data Collection Rules
content.noDataMessage: No Data Collection Rules found in the selected scope.

content.query:
insightsresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/datacollectionruleassociations'
| where isnotnull(properties.dataCollectionRuleId)
| where tostring(properties.dataCollectionRuleId) =~ '{SelectedDCR}'
// Derive the target resource ID by stripping the DCRA extension path
| extend targetId = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.insights/datacollectionruleassociations')[0])
| extend targetRG = tostring(split(targetId, '/')[4])
| extend targetType = case(
    targetId contains '/virtualmachines/', 'Virtual Machine',
    targetId contains '/virtualmachinescalesets/', 'VMSS',
    targetId contains '/managedclusters/', 'AKS',
    targetId contains '/machines/', 'Arc Machine',
    'Other')
| project targetId,
    Association = name,
    ['Resource Group'] = targetRG,
    ['Target Type'] = targetType,
    ['Provisioning State'] = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| order by ['Target Type'] asc, targetId asc

content.noDataMessage: No associations found for this DCR.
